title: File:Cattle died from plastic.jpg
desc:
Unnecessary death. Polyethylene / polythene plastic  in form of wraps, bags, foils kills many thousands of cows every year. In India alone. Do stop using it! Actually cattle is dying more of starvation than the poisoning!

Leh, Jammu and Kashmir, Indien
